headline: Telluride Medical Center goes before Regular Board Meeting -- Special Meeting on Tuesday, November 3
blurb: A short special meeting — just 30 minutes on the books — with one substantive item: a proposal from Jensen Partners to provide support through the due diligence process with CommonSpirit. CommonSpirit Health is one of the largest nonprofit hospital systems in the country, and any formal due diligence engagement signals that a potential partnership, affiliation, or transaction is being evaluated seriously.

meeting.title: Regular Board Meeting -- Special Meeting
